decisions.decision: Keep provider-level and venue-level OI/funding observations separate until instrument universe, contract coverage, notional basis and timestamp alignment are reconciled.
decisions.reason: Current Liqwall snapshot shows aggregate negative funding but positive Binance funding; other trackers report materially different OI totals.

decisions.decision: Every ETF flow record must carry fund universe, coverage numerator/denominator, missing funds, unit (USD or XRP), event date, retrieval time and source method. Never combine partial and complete totals.
decisions.reason: October 29 trackers report +$8.4M at 5/5, +$7.1M at 2/5 and +6.4M XRP across a different universe.

decisions.decision: Store company incident estimates, frozen amounts, recovered amounts, on-chain transfers and wallet attribution as separate evidence types. Do not equate frozen with recovered or explorer labels with official ownership.
decisions.reason: The incident estimate and five-wallet XRP trace have different provenance and confidence.

decisions.decision: Represent Coinbase's Permission relationship as embedded-wallet infrastructure and private-key custody for ASK users. Do not infer proprietary ASK exposure, exchange listing, XRP demand or XRPL integration.
decisions.reason: Permission's own announcement explicitly describes the wallet/key arrangement; its official ASK contracts list Base and Polygon only.

decisions.decision: Keep subscription-funded ASK buybacks as an issuer-described mechanism until actual on-chain buyback transactions and subscription revenue are reconciled.
decisions.reason: Tokenomics documentation is not execution evidence.

decisions.decision: Maintain separate identifiers SBIC_EAST_JAPAN and SBIC_SOCIAL_BIAS_INFERENCE_CORPUS. Treat the 65.9%/60.6% paper values as human preference rates, never accuracy.
decisions.reason: The same acronym refers to unrelated entities; Table 7 defines its metric as model preferred over gold annotations.

decisions.decision: Do not admit this run's market observations into the prediction model yet; preserve as timestamped research observations and keep forecast status NOT_ISSUED.
decisions.reason: Provider coverage, fund universe and point-in-time comparability remain incomplete.
